title: Siren (SIREN) 📈 97.5%

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Siren's current valuation is unsustainable—its protocol lacks real-world adoption and faces fierce competition from more established blockchains.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Siren's recent upgrades, like dynamic fee markets and cross-chain interoperability, are game-changers that justify the rally.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Those features are still in beta. Mainnet performance and user traction are missing—key metrics that define long-term value.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But the community-driven governance model and low transaction fees are attracting developers, which will drive adoption.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This rally is just the beginning—Siren's vision aligns with the future of scalable, decentralized networks.

caption_text: Siren is overvalued vs Siren rally is justified
